reason.stale-token: Its sign-in has expired. Sign in again.
reason.version-below-range: It works, but {{version}} is older than the versions Agentry has been tested with ({{range}}).
reason.version-above-range: {{version}} is newer than what Agentry knows how to use ({{range}}). Install an earlier one and choose it here.
reason.version-unreadable: Its version could not be read, so Agentry cannot tell whether it is compatible.
reason.probe-timeout: It could not be checked: it did not answer in time.
reason.spawn-denied: This system does not let Agentry run the program. Check its permissions.
reason.spawn-failed: The program was found but would not start.
reason.binary-not-found: There is no trace of {{label}} on this machine.
reason.config-home-only: There is configuration in {{home}}, but the program cannot be found.
reason.missing-required-command: A command it needs is missing on this machine.
reason.unsupported-platform: It does not run on this operating system.
reason.handshake-failed: It started but did not answer the way Agentry expects.
reason.no-probe: Agentry cannot check this one yet.
reason.disabled: It is not searched for or checked while it is off.
